subject: english
title: Signal Words
objective: Identify words that show order, reason, contrast, or result in a text.
introduction: Milo is writing about his school day and needs words that connect each idea. Can you spot order, reason, contrast, and result clues?

vocabulary.definition: a word that tells where an event falls in a sequence
a word that explains why something happens
a word that places two different ideas side by side

activities.instruction: Read the sentences and notice each word that connects ideas.
activities.content: Signal words help readers understand how ideas connect: first shows order, because shows a reason, and so shows a result.

feedback.retry: Name the relationship before choosing the signal word.

activities.prompt: Learn how signal words show relationships between ideas.
activities.narration: Signal words give readers a map: first shows order, because gives a reason, but shows a contrast, and so shows a result.
activities.guideHint: Ask whether the word shows order, a reason, a contrast, or a result.
activities.accessibilityAlternative: Signal words give readers a map: first shows order, because gives a reason, but shows a contrast, and so shows a result.

activities.instruction: Tap sentences that use a signal word to connect ideas.

items.prompt: Milo explains why his game moved indoors after rain. Which sentence links the ideas with a result word?

options.text: It rained, so the plants grew.
The sun came out at noon.

items.explanation: So links the rain to what happened afterward: the plants grew as a result.

items.prompt: Milo leaves ice in the sun. Which sentence shows the result?

options.text: The ice is in a cup.
The ice warmed, so it melted.

items.explanation: So connects the reason, warming ice, to the result, melting.

items.prompt: Milo practices drawing every day. Which sentence shows the result of his practice?
items.explanation: So shows that improving happened as a result of practicing.

items.prompt: The school bell rings. Which sentence connects the bell to what happens next?

options.text: The bell hangs on the wall.
The bell rang, so class began.

items.explanation: So connects the bell ringing with the result that class began.

items.prompt: Milo chooses a sentence that uses a connection word correctly. Which choice works?

options.text: The sun came out at noon.
It rained, so the plants grew.

items.explanation: So joins the rain and the plant growth, showing that the growth followed as a result.
